resources.string: Economy autopilot
Let autopilot manage trade, priority orders, taxes, stimulus, currency, bank rates and pricing during play.
During play, autopilot reviews trade, credit, prices and the treasury.
Autopilot lowered the bank’s reserve requirement after loans or payments were blocked.
Autopilot lowered the interest rate to help borrowers with frozen accounts.
When trade stalled, autopilot used treasury funds to help workers and farms trade again.
Autopilot created currency to rebuild bank reserves after credit and trade stalled.
Autopilot found trouble but has reached its limits. You can step in or let it check again during play.
Autopilot raised the reserve requirement as trade recovered.
Autopilot raised the interest rate as trade recovered.
Autopilot retired surplus treasury currency while trade was healthy.
Autopilot distributed treasury funds to an industry short of cash.
Autopilot bought a commodity from a private seller.
Autopilot placed a buy order that waits for an affordable price.
Autopilot offered treasury inventory for sale.
Autopilot closed a trade order that no longer met its inventory or spending limits.
Autopilot placed a priority order for a commodity in short supply.
Autopilot broke stalled priority obligations so ordinary trade could resume.
Autopilot started collecting taxes to replenish the treasury.
Autopilot suspended tax collection.
Autopilot adjusted the tax rates for current market conditions.
Autopilot switched to stable pricing after repeated large price changes.
Autopilot restored supply-and-demand pricing after prices settled.
